Kerala Suspends Engineer After Boy's Electrocution Death

An engineer from the Kerala State Electricity Board (KSEB) has been suspended following the electrocution death of a 13-year-old boy in Tirurangadi. The Human Rights Commission (HRC) has registered a case related to the incident.
